key_insight: QuantumChain combines hybrid quantum-classical federated learning with encryption and blockchain to improve privacy-preserving fraud detection while preserving strong recall.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets realistic financial settings where data are decentralized, imbalanced, and privacy-sensitive, making it relevant for secure edge/fintech deployment.
method: Hybrid quantum-classical local models with a variational quantum circuit inserted between classical neural layers
Encrypted federated aggregation using homomorphic encryption, threshold secret sharing, and QKD-based keying
Permissioned blockchain for auditability and reputation-weighted trust across clients
evidence_signal: On financial transaction data, the HQNN matched classical accuracy while improving fraud-class recall to 94.6% vs 93.2%, and federated accuracy rose from 97.7% to 98.8% over five rounds with 10 heterogeneous clients.
watch_item: The reported gains depend on compact simulations and a permissioned, carefully managed security stack, so real-world deployment may face scalability and quantum-hardware constraints.
paper_title: QuantumChain: Blockchain-Backed Quantum Federated Learning for Financial Fraud Detection
